description: This is a Java test class named HiveMqtt3PublisherActorTest that tests the functionality of the HiveMqtt3PublisherActor, a component responsible for publishing MQTT messages using the HiveMQ client in a specific project context. The test verifies message publishing, targeting, and acknowledgement handling.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3PublisherActorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that validates MQTT message publishing via HiveMQ client, including message payload correctness, target addressing, and acknowledgement handling.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock HiveMQ MQTT client and asynchronous client, configuring publish behavior to record messages.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Provides Akka actor Props configured with test parameters for HiveMqtt3PublisherActor.

methods.name: decorateTarget
methods.description: Adds addressing and acknowledgement label to a Target object.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Asserts that a message has been published with expected topic and payload.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Asserts that the message to the reply target has the correct topic.

methods.name: verifyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks that acknowledgements are received and have correct label and status.

methods.name: getOutboundAddress
methods.description: Returns the outbound MQTT address used in the tests.
